Adrian Park: Hey CS — quick transfer after today's demo with HeliosMed. They signed for Dedicated + Private (VPC) with SSO. Key contacts below. We need provisioning, SSO, and a short runbook handed over. High priority for HIPAA compliance.
Maya Chen: Thanks Adrian. Can you post customer contacts & initial SSO provider? ETA for provisioning?
Adrian Park: Contacts — Dr. Nina Shah <nina@heliosmed.com>, IT lead Marcus Li <marcus@heliosmed.com>. They prefer Okta. Demo went well; they care about audit logs + KMS. Target go-live: 2024-07-15.
Maya Chen: Got it. I'll schedule kickoff for Tues. Samir, can you own onboarding checklists + Support training?
Samir Patel: On it. I'll run the preflight checklist, verify SAML metadata, and own the first 90 days. Need Okta SAML metadata + admin contact.
Leo Morales: I'll pick up Private deployment planning. Need model name/version (we'll default to redwood/med-2.1 unless they specified), expected peak RPS and seq len. Also any special quantization reqs?
Adrian Park: Model: med-2.1 (baseline). Peak: ~15 RPS, burst to 40 for batch imports. Avg seq len ~600 tokens. No custom quantization requests flagged.
ProvisionBot: Reservation created: dedicated-pool: heliosmed-pool, 2xA10G, tentative until 2024-07-01. Please confirm capacity via /reserve CLI.
Maya Chen: Thanks — Leo, Samir, I'll add owners to the kickoff invite: https://calendar.example.com/heliosmed-kickoff. Agenda: SSO handshake, infra provisioning, data residency, alerting, rollback plan.
Samir Patel: Adding support runbook items: ticket templates, escalation path to eng, and Customer SLAs. Sharing draft in #support-docs after this.
Leo Morales: I'll open infra ticket: INF-8391. Posting initial config snippet:
```
cluster: heliosmed-prod
gpus: 2xA10G
model: redwood/med-2.1
network: private-vpc peering -> customer
kms: aws-kms:alias/heliosmed
```
Maya Chen: Adrian — can you confirm data retention policy preference and any IP allowlist?
Adrian Park: They want 90-day retention, IP allowlist to include 3 CIDRs sent to Marcus. Also want audit log exports to their S3.
Maya Chen: Perfect. Action owners: Maya (CS) — kickoff & runbook lead; Samir (Support) — onboarding + runbook; Leo (Eng) — infra & private deploy; Adrian (Sales) — exec sponsor & customer contact. I'll post a concise transfer doc after the call. :white_check_mark:
ProvisionBot: SLA package flagged: enterprise-hipaa. Please confirm procurement sign-off.
Samir Patel: I'll confirm procurement contact on the call.
Maya Chen: Great — tagging this thread with owners and following up with tickets. Anyone see a blocker? :eyes:
Adrian Park: No blockers from sales side. :tada:
Maya Chen: Closing for now — will re-open with kickoff notes + links.
